svg.font-family: Segoe UI, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Chat from the Web UI, Streamed
svg.desc: The browser posts to the Next.js proxy, which adds the API key and forwards to FastAPI. The route resolves the gem (one store query per gem in the tree), adds remembered context when the gem asks for it, asks the router which AI to use, and streams the provider's text back to the browser as server-sent events.
svg.text: Chat from the Web UI, Streamed
One question from the chat page to the AI and back, token by token
loop once per gem in the reference tree
opt the gem remembers earlier work
prompt: references expanded, blanks checked and filled, examples in
